name: vibeaudit
description: Local-first AI-aware repository security auditor for secrets, vulnerabilities, policy gates, and ISO evidence support.

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @vibeaudit/security build && corepack pnpm --filter @vibeaudit/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @vibeaudit/iso build && corepack pnpm --filter @vibeaudit/runner build && corepack pnpm --filter @vibeaudit/api build && corepack pnpm --filter @vibeaudit/web build
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm --filter @vibeaudit/security lint && corepack pnpm --filter @vibeaudit/core lint && corepack pnpm --filter @vibeaudit/iso lint && corepack pnpm --filter @vibeaudit/runner lint && corepack pnpm --filter @vibeaudit/api lint && corepack pnpm --filter @vibeaudit/web lint
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @vibeaudit/security typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @vibeaudit/core typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @vibeaudit/iso typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @vibeaudit/runner typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @vibeaudit/api typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @vibeaudit/web typecheck
